name: Divorce Is My Best Christmas Gift
original_name: Divorce Is My Best Christmas Gift
overview: Five years ago, law school's brightest star, Hannah, dropped out for love, becoming the perfect wife to Congressman Ethan. This Christmas Eve, her dream wedding turns into a nightmare — Ethan sweeps his first love into his arms and runs. Heartbroken, Hannah returns to campus under Professor Daniel's guidance... Ethan finally realizes Hannah is the one he loves.
